name: com.classicspins.rating
description: A drop-in "rate this game" prompt, taken from the Money Sort prototype: after the player wins a chosen level (once per install) a 5-star popup asks how the game is; 4-5 stars opens the store's write-a-review page, fewer stars opens a feedback link, and a thank-you shows when the player comes back. The flow is engine-free and unit-testable; a code-built default popup (no prefab, no TMP) works out of the box, or a game draws its own. No dependency on PrototypeFramework.
